points: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all. A Christian would say, to hell with all of those facts you just showed, because of this scripture right here: Greeks, Barbarians, Scythians, those are the other nations. Really, after we just read all of that in context? So we are going to go over it.
